main.description: A video registered for inclusion in a consent-first dataset (version 2 of org.consentvid.video). The record commits to the bytes by content hash and says where they are stored; it does not hold them. Its consent, if any, is the org.consentvid.consentV2 record in the same repo with the same record key (a sidecar record). Records are public: never put personal data or filesystem paths in them.

contentHash.description: The video bytes' CIDv1 with the raw codec and a sha-256 multihash, in base32 (bafkrei...): the same value a PDS blob ref carries for these bytes. Readers reject any other codec or hash.

size.description: Size of the video bytes, in bytes.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the video bytes. Readers reject values outside knownValues: it becomes the dataset's encodingFormat, which dataset loaders act on.

langs.description: Spoken languages, primary first (BCP-47, lowercase primary subtag, e.g. en, cs, pt-BR).

storage.description: Where the bytes live. Readers that don't know a storage type treat the bytes as unreachable.

labels.description: Self-labels the contributor applies to the video (e.g. 'nudity', 'sexual', 'porn', 'graphic-media'). Dataset tools leave labeled clips out unless asked to include them.

r2Ref.description: The public https URL of a Cloudflare R2 object.

url.description: https URL on a public host and the default port, without credentials.

cid.description: The IPFS CID: CIDv1 in lowercase base32 (b...) or CIDv0 (Qm...); IPFS commonly uses codecs other than atproto's, so this is not format 'cid'.

peertubeRef.description: A video on a PeerTube instance.

url.description: https watch or download URL on a public host and the default port, without credentials.

urlRef.description: Bytes at a public https URL.

url.description: https URL on a public host and the default port, without credentials.

localRef.description: Bytes kept by the contributor, not published. Never dereferenced.

name.description: An opaque name (no control characters). Never a filesystem path: records are public.
